question: How to Size a Safety Relief Valve (PSV)?
body_html:
Safety relief valve (PSV) sizing finds the orifice area needed to relieve the worst credible overpressure scenario using API 520, then selects the next larger API 526 orifice, never a smaller one.

A = W ÷ (C × Kd × P1 × Kb × Kc) × √(T × Z ÷ M)

Example: W = 5,000 lb/hr, C = 315, Kd = 0.975, P1 = 165 psia, T = 610 °R, Z = 1, M = 44 gives A ≈ 0.367 in².
